Florida Poodle Rescue’s Mission Statement

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.4.5″ text_font=”||||||||” hover_enabled=”0″]

Florida Poodle Rescue, Inc. is a non-profit 501(c)(3) dedicated to the rescue and placement of Poodles and Poodle mixes. Our organization’s primary activity is rescuing abused, abandoned and unwanted Poodles. Prior to adoption, we provide professional veterinary care, including spay/neuter, as well as behavioral care and rehabilitation. Poodles are placed in caring, permanent adopted homes where they will be cherished family members for the duration of their lives. We are committed to engaging and educating the public about the rescue process in general, and Poodles in particular.
